message.content: In the conversation, Jennifer Moore congratulates Li Hua on pushing her limits with the bench press. Specifically, Jennifer encourages Li Hua, saying "I can't wait to see you crush that weight! Just make sure to warm up properly. You've got this!" and later emphasizes the importance of focusing on form as she increases the weight, stating "Just remember to focus on your form as you increase the weight. Let’s make it an epic workout session! 😄💪". Jennifer also mentions their upcoming session together, highlighting the opportunity to "make it an epic workout session" and encouraging Li Hua to "Keep pushing those limits together!". Therefore, Jennifer Moore is the one who congratulates Li Hua on pushing her limits with the bench press.
